items.description: File category the generator must read.

referencedTags.description: Tags from other configurations whose classes may be referenced in code generated by this module's generators.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the configuration from which to retrieve the tag.

oneOf.description:
Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `ts`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `ts`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

variables.description: Global configuration variables that can be used in all configuration properties.

tagVariables.description: Per-tag configuration variables that can be used in configuration properties that support them.

rootModule.description:
Root module definition used for grouping generated artifacts, such as translation files.

- Default: `{module:head}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.

ignoreDefaultValues.description:
Disables generation of default property values in classes and endpoints generated with this configuration.

- Default: `false`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

disable.description: Generators to disable for this configuration.

modelRootPath.description:
Model output location, relative to the generation directory. If omitted, no model is generated. If `{module}` is absent from the path, it is appended.

- Templating: `{module}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

enumsFileName.description:
Name of the generated file containing a module's enums.

- Default: `enums`.

resourceRootPath.description:
I18n resource location, relative to the generation directory. If omitted, no file is generated. If `{lang}` is absent from the path, it is appended.

- Templating: `{module}`, `{lang}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiClientRootPath.description:
API client location, relative to the generation directory. If omitted, no file is generated.

- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiClientFilePath.description:
Path where generated endpoint files are created, relative to the API root.

- Default: `{module}/{fileName}` (in Angular mode: `{module}/{fileName}.service`).
- Templating: `{module}`, `{fileName}`.

fetchPath.description:
Path or import for a custom `fetch`; relative to the generation directory when it starts with `.`.

- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

domainPath.description:
Path or import for the `domain` file; relative to the generation directory when it starts with `.`.

- Default: `./domains`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

apiMode.description:
Target framework for JavaScript API client generation.

- Default: `fetch`.

extendedCompositions.description: Generates `isRequired`, `label` (and `comment`) on compositions in typed entities.

optionalPrimaryKeys.description: Generates simple primary keys (and their aliases) as optional in entity definitions. This compatibility setting should not be used in new projects.

entityTypesPath.description: Path (or alias starting with `@`) to entity type imports, relative to the generation directory.

generateComments.description: Adds comments to generated JS entities.

generateMainResourceFiles.description: Generates an `index.ts` file that imports and re-exports all generated resource files by language. Only compatible with `resourceMode: js`.
